title: St. Michael’s Camp

services.name: Summer Camp Programs
services.desc: There is much to do around St. Michael’s Camp area, within Duck Mountain Provincial Park. St. Michael’s Camp is located on just about 9 acres on the shore of Madge Lake. It is accessible by fully-paved Provincial Park roads, located in the BENITO sub-division of Duck Mountain Provincial Park. There are 11 fully furnished suites built directly into the main hall building that can be used as part of a facility rental. A lockable door separates the hall from the suites, and each suite has its own separate lock and key.
